description: Cancel up to 50 named orders in one call. Sits between cancelling one hash and cancelling everything: a maker re-quoting part of a ladder wants neither six round trips nor a teardown of the book it is about to rebuild. Every hash is reported on its own — unknown, already terminal, or not yours does not stop the rest — because cancellation reduces risk, and a batch that refused wholesale would leave exposure the caller explicitly asked to drop. Hosted and terminal: nothing to broadcast, no gas owed.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reuse only with byte-equivalent tool arguments.

orderHashes.description: Order hashes to cancel, up to 50. Duplicates are collapsed.

proofNonce.description: Required single-use nonce for the wallet proof. Fetch from POST /api/auth/nonce; consumed on verification so the proof cannot be replayed.

signatureTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) used in the signed challenge message

walletAddress.description: Wallet address that owns the orders

walletSignature.description: Action-bound wallet proof. Sign the canonical 'problee-mcp-auth:…' challenge (binds agent, apiKey, tool, scope, chain, resource, payloadHash, nonce, timestamp).

name: kellian_cancel_orders
title: Cancel a named set of orders in one call, reporting each hash independently
